result.description:
Speech Pathologist (Paediatric & Community Services – NDIS)
Employer: EDS Support Australia Pty Ltd
Position: Speech Pathologist
Employment Type: Full-Time (Part-Time may be considered)
Location: Mareeba, Far North Queensland, with regular travel throughout Cairns, Tablelands, Cape York and surrounding regional, remote and very remote communities.
Salary: $95,000 – $125,000 per annum + Superannuation + Travel Allowance (where applicable)
Reports To: Clinical Manager / Director
________________________________________
About EDS Support Australia Pty Ltd
EDS Support Australia Pty Ltd is a community-based allied health and disability service provider delivering high-quality services throughout Far North Queensland. We support children, adolescents and adults through NDIS-funded and community-based programs, focusing on early intervention, capacity building, communication, independence and participation.
We are committed to delivering culturally safe, person-centred and evidence-based services across metropolitan, regional, remote and very remote communities.
________________________________________
Position Summary
The Speech Pathologist will provide comprehensive assessment, diagnosis, intervention and ongoing therapy services for children with developmental delays, communication disorders, autism spectrum disorder, intellectual disability, neurological conditions and other complex needs.
The role primarily supports children funded through the NDIS and community programs while working collaboratively with families, schools, childcare centres, healthcare providers and multidisciplinary teams.
This position requires extensive community outreach and travel throughout Far North Queensland, including remote and very remote communities.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
The Speech Pathologist will:
•	Conduct comprehensive speech, language, communication, literacy and swallowing assessments.
•	Assess children presenting with developmental delays and complex communication needs.
•	Complete functional assessments that support NDIS access and plan reviews.
•	Develop evidence-based therapy plans aligned with participant goals.
•	Deliver individual and group therapy sessions.
•	Provide early childhood intervention services.
•	Prepare high-quality clinical reports, assessment reports, progress reports and therapy recommendations.
•	Develop communication strategies for home, school and community environments.
•	Prescribe and implement Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) systems where appropriate.
•	Educate parents, carers, teachers and support workers.
•	Participate in multidisciplinary case conferences.
•	Liaise with paediatricians, GPs, psychologists, occupational therapists, physiotherapists, educators and support coordinators.
•	Maintain accurate documentation consistent with NDIS Practice Standards.
•	Provide outreach services across regional, remote and very remote communities.
•	Deliver services via clinic, home visits, schools, childcare centres, community settings and telehealth where appropriate.
•	Participate in quality improvement activities and professional development.
________________________________________
Essential Selection Criteria
Applicants must possess:
Qualifications
•	Bachelor or Master's Degree in Speech Pathology.
•	Eligibility for Certified Practising Speech Pathologist (CPSP) status with Speech Pathology Australia.
Experience
•	Minimum two (2) years' clinical experience (desirable).
•	Experience assessing and treating children with communication disorders.
•	Experience working within the NDIS.
•	Experience working in community-based allied health services.
•	Demonstrated experience completing functional assessments and clinical reports.
•	Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
Skills
•	Excellent assessment and clinical reasoning skills.
•	Strong report writing ability.
•	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
•	Ability to work independently.
•	Effective time management.
•	Strong organisational skills.
•	Ability to manage a varied caseload.
•	High level of cultural awareness.
•	Commitment to evidence-based practice.
Mandatory Requirements
•	AHPRA Registration – Speech Pathologist
•	Current Australian Driver Licence (Essential).
•	Willingness to travel regularly throughout Far North Queensland.
•	Ability to work in regional, remote and very remote communities.
•	Current NDIS Worker Screening Clearance.
•	Current Queensland Blue Card (Working with Children Check).
•	Current National Police Check.
•	Current First Aid and CPR Certificate.
•	COVID-19 and other vaccinations as required by funding bodies or host organisations.
•	Australian working rights or eligibility for employer-sponsored visa.
________________________________________
Desirable
•	Experience working with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.
•	Rural and remote healthcare experience.
•	Experience with AAC systems.
•	Knowledge of Positive Behaviour Support.
•	Experience delivering telehealth services.
•	Experience with paediatric feeding and swallowing disorders.
•	Knowledge of sensory communication approaches.
________________________________________
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The successful Speech Pathologist will:
•	Meet agreed billable clinical targets.
•	Complete assessments within organisational timeframes.
•	Maintain high-quality clinical documentation.
•	Achieve participant goal outcomes.
•	Maintain participant satisfaction.
•	Participate in clinical supervision.
•	Maintain professional development requirements.
•	Comply with NDIS Practice Standards and organisational policies.
•	Demonstrate effective collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.
________________________________________
Compliance Requirements
The successful applicant must comply with:
•	NDIS Practice Standards.
•	NDIS Code of Conduct.
•	Child Safe Standards.
•	Privacy legislation.
•	Workplace Health and Safety requirements.
•	Infection prevention and control procedures.
•	Mandatory reporting obligations.
•	Clinical governance framework.
•	Continuous Quality Improvement activities.
________________________________________
Benefits
EDS Support Australia Pty Ltd offers:
•	Competitive salary package.
•	Superannuation.
•	Professional development allowance.
•	Paid professional development leave.
•	Clinical supervision and mentoring.
•	Flexible work arrangements.
•	Travel reimbursement.
•	Laptop and mobile phone.
•	Career progression opportunities.
•	Opportunity to work within a multidisciplinary allied health team.
•	Employer-sponsored visa opportunities for suitable overseas applicants who meet Australian migration and professional registration requirements.
________________________________________
Employer-Sponsored Visa Eligibility (where applicable)
Suitable international applicants may be considered if they:
•	Meet Australian migration requirements for employer sponsorship.
•	Hold recognised Speech Pathology qualifications – AHPRA Registration
•	Meet English language requirements.
•	Are eligible for Certified Practising Speech Pathologist (CPSP) status with Speech Pathology Australia.
•	Meet all pre-employment screening requirements.
________________________________________
Our Commitment
EDS Support Australia Pty Ltd is committed to safeguarding children and vulnerable people. We value diversity and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, culturally and linguistically diverse communities, and professionals committed to improving health outcomes across regional, remote and very remote Australia.

Location: 		Arundel, QLD, 4214
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Reports to:		Workshop Foreman / Production Manager
Job Title: 		Carpenter
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a meticulous and experienced Carpenter with specialized expertise in fine cabinetmaking and custom joinery. This is a full-time, permanent position based in their modern Arundel workshop. The successful candidate will be integral to transforming architectural concepts into tangible, heirloom-quality installations. You will report directly to the Workshop Foreman and collaborate with a team of dedicated craftspeople and designers.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Design Interpretation & Material Preparation:
• Accurately analyse and interpret detailed technical drawings, CAD designs, and shop plans for custom cabinetry, complex joinery, and freestanding furniture.
• Plan and sequence the workflow, meticulously selecting appropriate timber species, veneers, laminates, and composite materials to meet exact design specifications and project timelines.

Precision Machining & Fabrication:
• Expertly operate a range of hand tools, power tools, and advanced workshop machinery including panel saws, thicknessers, routers, and CNC equipment to cut, shape, and prepare components.
• Fabricate bespoke cabinets, shelving units, countertops, and architectural millwork with exceptional attention to detail, adhering to tolerances within 1mm variance.

Expert Joinery & Component Assembly:
• Execute and implement advanced joinery techniques such as dovetail, mortise-and-tenon, and domino joinery to ensure both structural integrity and aesthetic appeal.
• Assemble components using specialized adhesives, fasteners, and clamping systems, guaranteeing seamless alignment, perfect squareness, and flawless integration of all parts.

Finishing, Detailing & Hardware Application:
• Skilfully apply veneers, laminates, and edge-banding to achieve invisible seams and pristine surfaces.
• Perform multi-stage sanding, staining, sealing, and finishing processes to produce a superior final coat as per client specifications, including matte, satin, or gloss finishes.
• Precisely install and calibrate high-end hardware such as soft-close hinges, drawer runners, and custom handles to ensure flawless operation and functionality.

Quality Assurance & Workshop Excellence:
• Conduct rigorous quality inspections of both raw materials and finished products, ensuring strict compliance with design intent, safety standards, and the company’s renowned quality benchmarks.
• Proactively identify and troubleshoot construction or fit issues, implementing effective corrective measures with a solutions-oriented mindset.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and highly organized workshop environment in line with 5S principles and all Work Health & Safety (WHS) regulations, including strict adherence to PPE protocols.

Skills & Experience Required:
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
• A formal qualification such as a Certificate III in Cabinet Making or Carpentry is essential.
• A minimum of 2 years of proven post-apprenticeship experience within a high-end commercial joinery, cabinetmaking, or furniture manufacturing workshop.
• Demonstrable portfolio showcasing experience with solid timber, veneers, and engineered board products.

Technical Proficiencies:
• High competency in traditional and modern joinery methods, precision machining, and hand-finishing techniques.
• Proven experience safely operating and performing basic maintenance on workshop machinery, including CNC routers and panel saws.

Personal Attributes:
• An unwavering eye for detail and a deep-seated pride in producing work of exceptional craftsmanship.
• A self-managed, proactive work ethic with strong problem-solving abilities and the initiative to work independently.
• Excellent communication skills and a collaborative spirit to work effectively with designers, project managers, and fellow tradespeople.
• The physical capability to perform manual tasks, including lifting materials up to 25kg, and standing for extended periods in a workshop setting.

What’s On Offer:
This is a exceptional opportunity for a passionate carpenter to advance their career with an industry leader. You will be provided with a permanent full-time role, a competitive remuneration package commensurate with experience, and the chance to work on prestigious projects with premium materials. You will join a supportive, skilled team in a well-resourced, modern facility.

Application Process:
If you are a craftsman dedicated to excellence and your skills align with this specialist role, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience through the provided application portal. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.
We are acting as an exclusive recruitment partner for this position. Please note that our client's company name has been withheld as per our agency agreement.

Type: Full-time

Location: Blanchetown SA 5357
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Moorookclub Pty Ltd operates Blanchetown Foodery, a vibrant one-stop destination in the heart of Blanchetown, South Australia, encompassing a cafe, restaurant, and supermarket. The business specialises in delivering a diverse multi-cuisine experience, featuring Italian, Indian, and fast-food options alongside everyday grocery needs. Known for its convenient, high-quality offerings and friendly service in a regional community setting, Blanchetown Foodery values fresh ingredients, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence. It fosters a supportive, team-oriented workplace culture where dedication to food service and community connection are highly regarded.
About the Position:
The Chef plays a central role at Blanchetown Foodery within Moorookclub Pty Ltd, leading the preparation and delivery of high-quality dishes across the cafe and restaurant operations. This position involves creating appealing menus, maintaining exceptional food standards, and contributing to the smooth running of a busy multi-cuisine venue that serves both locals and visitors. The role is essential for upholding the business’s reputation for delicious, diverse food and ensuring an outstanding dining experience that supports the venue’s position as a community favourite.
Key Responsibilities:
Planning menus, estimating food and labour costs, and ordering food supplies.
Monitoring quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation.
Discussing food preparation issues with Managers, Dietitians and kitchen and waiting staff.
Demonstrating techniques and advising on cooking procedures.
Preparing and cooking food.
Explaining and enforcing hygiene regulations.
Selecting and training staff (as required).
Freezing and preserving foods (as required).
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma in a relevant field (such as Commercial Cookery or Hospitality Management).
Minimum 3 years’ work experience as a Chef.
Strong technical skills in multi-cuisine food preparation (including Italian, Indian, and fast food), menu planning, cost control, and presentation.
Excellent knowledge of food safety, hygiene regulations, and quality standards.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and provide guidance to kitchen staff.

At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers 
A fantastic opportunity to lead product design within a squad to deliver world class products for our cabin crew
Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide   

Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.

Are you passionate about crafting great mobile experiences? AA.

generate code (e.g., Figma's AI plugins, ClaudeCode, Cursor, Lovable).
Advanced logical reasoning and sound decision-making, including numerical
analysis.
Ability to identify and address flawed logic and coach teams to resolve errors. 
Proven ability to solve high-impact design challenges in large, complex
organisations.
Expert facilitation skills, with a track record of successful outcomes.
Inspirational leadership for both direct and remote teams.
Clear communication of design concepts to stakeholders, adapting to the audience.
Extensive knowledge of current digital design standards and industry trends.
Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.? 

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers. 

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless. 

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.? 

We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.

We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.?
Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

By combining senior-level technical craftsmanship, and daily operational support of lab processes and systems, Senior Dental Technician ensures optimal efficiency, maintains exemplary quality control, and drives the delivery of world-class custom dental solutions.  Key Responsibilities & Duties  Part A: Senior Fabrication, Technical & Laboratory Coordination Duties    Laboratory Operations & Case Coordination:  Support daily laboratory workflows, coordinate case schedules, and prioritise production lines to ensure all internal and external restorative cases are delivered on time and to flawless standards.   Prosthetic Fabrication & Artistry:  Design, model, and fabricate high-end, complex dental prosthetics and appliances (including fixed/removable restorations, custom implant abutments, All-on-4/X frameworks, and surgical templates) using advanced CAD/CAM software (e.g., 3Shape, exocad).   Inventory & Procurement Control:  Coordinate laboratory inventory, track stock levels, order dental materials, and coordinate relationships with external suppliers and specialty laboratories.   Equipment Maintenance & Digital Assets:  Perform routine use, calibration, and troubleshooting with the use of laboratory equipment (including desktop/intraoral scanners, 3D printers, and milling units). Manage digital software updates, licenses, and technical backups.   Material Processing:  Expertly select, prepare, and process high-end dental materials (ceramics, composites, acrylics, and metals) in strict accordance with clinical prescriptions.   Shade Selection & Aesthetics:  Work to perform custom shade-matching, characterisation, staining, and glazing to achieve high-aesthetic, lifelike results.   Quality Assurance & Compliance:  Establish and enforce strict quality control protocols. Inspect all fabricated items for alignment, and aesthetic standards. Manage repairs, relines, and adjustments.   Workplace Safety:  Ensure the laboratory environment strictly complies with health, safety, and infection control protocols.      Part B: Technical-Clinical Integration & Leadership    Workflow Coordination:  Support the fabrication lab, coordinating schedules and communication to provide technical alignment.   Data Management:  Systematically organise, back up, and store digital files, STL scans, and photographs securely and in compliance with privacy regulations.   Mentorship & Guidance:  Offer technical guidance and support to other dental technicians or junior team members where relevant.   Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)    Quality of Output & QA:  Maintain an exceptionally low remake and adjustment rate, ensuring finished prosthetics fit passably and smoothly on first delivery.   Laboratory Efficiency & Timeliness:  Maintain highly organized laboratory schedules, ensuring all work is ready and quality-checked.   Inventory & Resource Management:  Provide support with stock levels, and equipment undertake other technical tasks during downtime through proactive maintenance.   Support & Integration:  Maintain high standards of proactive support and support seamless transitions between laboratory fabrication and clinic demands.   Compliance & Safety:  Achieve 100% compliance with workplace health and safety (WHS), infection control guidelines, and data privacy standards.   Skills, Qualifications, and Experience  Experience:   Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in high-end dental fabrication, with deep expertise in dental anatomy, materials, and complex digital workflows.  Demonstrated experience in working in laboratory operations, workflows, and maintaining CAD/CAM machinery.    Technical Skills:    Advanced proficiency with digital dental design (CAD/CAM) software (e.g., exocad, 3Shape) and manufacturing hardware (3D printers, mills).    Interpersonal Skills:    Strong leadership capabilities with excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.  A warm, patient-focused, and empathetic presence.  Ability to work effectively and remain calm in a fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environment.    Desirable Attributes:    Familiarity with standard dental management software (e.g., Dental4Windows, Exact).   Physical Demands & Work Environment    Physical Demands:  The role requires fine-detailed manual dexterity for intricate technical tasks, the ability to sit or stand for extended periods, and excellent close-up vision (with magnification if required).   Work Environment:  Time is dynamically split between a sterile environment (requiring appropriate personal protective equipment) and a modern, technically advanced digital fabrication laboratory. Job Advertisement: Automotive Electrician
Company Name: N K Transport AUS Pty Ltd
Location: Pinkenba QLD 4008
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum

About the Company
N K Transport AUS Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based transport and logistics company providing courier, interstate freight, specialised transportation and logistics solutions across Australia. With a modern fleet, an in-house mechanical workshop and a strong commitment to reliability, safety and operational efficiency, the company delivers tailored transport services to a diverse range of commercial clients.

Role Overview
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Automotive Electrician to join our workshop team in Pinkenba, Queensland. The successful candidate will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, maintaining and installing electrical and electronic systems across the company's fleet of commercial vehicles and transport equipment to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operations.

Key Responsibilities
• Diagnose faults in electrical and electronic systems using specialised diagnostic equipment and testing instruments.
• Test, repair and replace electrical components including sensors, switches, relays, control modules and associated wiring.
• Install and maintain electronic accessories such as GPS tracking systems, reversing cameras, telematics, communication equipment and safety devices.
• Ensure all electrical repairs and installations comply with manufacturer specifications, workplace safety requirements and relevant Australian standards.
• Maintain accurate service records and communicate repair requirements with workshop supervisors and maintenance personnel.
• Inspect electrical systems to identify defects and perform preventative maintenance to minimise vehicle downtime.
• Install, repair and maintain vehicle wiring, lighting systems, alternators, starter motors, batteries and charging systems.
• Read and interpret electrical wiring diagrams, circuit schematics and technical service information to complete repairs accurately.

Skills and Experience
• AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV in Automotive Electrical Technology, or an equivalent qualification.
• Minimum of one (1) year of relevant full-time work experience as an Automotive Electrician.
• Strong knowledge of automotive electrical systems, electronic diagnostics and fault-finding techniques.
• Experience working on commercial vehicles, vans or light and heavy transport fleets will be highly regarded.
• Ability to interpret wiring diagrams and technical manuals.
• Proficiency in using automotive diagnostic equipment, electrical testing instruments and workshop tools.
• Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and quality workmanship.

Why Join Our Team
• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
• Stable full-time employment with opportunities for long-term career growth.
• Supportive and professional team environment.
• Modern workshop equipped with quality diagnostic equipment and tools.
• Opportunity to work on a diverse fleet of commercial transport vehicles within a growing logistics business.

How to Apply
If you meet the above qualifications and are looking to build your career with a growing transport and logistics company, please submit your resume outlining your skills,
qualifications and relevant experience. We welcome applications from motivated and experienced Automotive Electricians who are committed to delivering quality workmanship and maintaining the highest standards of vehicle safety and reliability.
